name: What information should I gather before requesting a window repair estimate?

mainEntity.name: What information should I gather before requesting a window repair estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: To help us provide the most accurate estimate, it's beneficial to gather specific details about your damaged window. Note the type of window (e.g., single-hung, double-hung, casement), the approximate size of the damaged area, and a description of the issue (e.g., cracked glass, broken latch, difficulty opening). Taking a photo of the damage can also be very helpful. This preparation allows us to understand the scope of work better before our on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before an estimate, gather window type, size of damage, and a description of the issue. Photos can also be helpful for an accurate assessment.
